suitableFor: coverage/feature overview grids on white backgrounds
'What does X cover?' style 3-to-4-up icon cards with a learn-more link
icon-led promo cards where each card links to a detail page
notSuitableFor: category overview sections on grey backgrounds (use cards-category)
image-led navigation tiles with no body copy (use cards-bop-tile / cards-tile)
cards with interactive controls like dropdowns/inputs (use cards-action)
